card.name: Modifier before an expected noun
card.fires_on: An adjective or modifier word that sits between a determiner or noun and the noun it describes, such as statewide, global, infant, family or household. It also fires on the middle of a longer word like maternally or posthumously.

modes.label: Scope adjective before noun
modes.description: Adjectives like global, statewide, family or State that narrow a following noun such as series, problem, garden or park.
modes.example: Illicit drugs are a<< global>> problem with more than 200

modes.label: Product or type modifier
modes.description: A modifier inside a noun phrase naming a kind of product, such as infant formula or household bleach.
modes.example: a can of Enfamil liquid<< infant>> formula and a Rubbermaid plastic food-storage

modes.label: Inside a longer word
modes.description: The middle piece of a multi-part word like maternally or posthumously.
modes.example: was published post<<hum>>ously. Fitzgerald also wrote many short stories

card.writes: It adds no clear shared output; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It marks a descriptive word that is waiting for the noun it modifies, like global or infant.
